title: Dasakam 99 – Vedamantramūlātmakaviṣṇustutiḥ
description: A praise of Vishnu through ritual, names and incarnations, cosmic presence, and the accessible divine form.

stanzas.sanskrit:
विष्णोर्वीर्याणि को वा कथयतु धरणेः कश्च रेणून्मिमीते
यस्यैवाङ्घ्रित्रयेण त्रिजगदभिमितं मोदते पूर्णसम्पत् ।
योऽसौ विश्वानि धत्ते प्रियमिह परमं धाम तस्याभियायां
त्वद्भक्ता यत्र माद्यन्त्यमृतरसमरन्दस्य यत्र प्रवाहः ॥ ९९-१ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Bhagwan Krishna measured the three worlds with his three strides and made this world experience joy,  wealth, and prosperity with a mere touch of HIS feet. HE is a supporter of the three worlds. The greatness of Bhagwan cannot be explained, just like how one cannot count the sand particles in the universe. Bhattathiri pleaded for a place in Vaikuntam, where the honey of immortality flows freely and devotees enjoy the bliss forever.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
viṣṇorvīryāṇi ko vā kathayatu dharaṇeḥ kaśca reṇūnmimīte
yasyaivāṅghritrayeṇa trijagadabhimitaṃ modate pūrṇasampat |
yo’sau viśvāni dhatte priyamiha paramaṃ dhāma tasyābhiyāyāṃ
tvadbhaktā yatra mādyantyamṛtarasamarandasya yatra pravāhaḥ || 99-1 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
आद्यायाशेषकर्त्रे प्रतिनिमिषनवीनाय भर्त्रे विभूते-
-र्भक्तात्मा विष्णवे यः प्रदिशति हविरादीनि यज्ञार्चनादौ ।
कृष्णाद्यं जन्म यो वा महदिह महतो वर्णयेत्सोऽयमेव
प्रीतः पूर्णो यशोभिस्त्वरितमभिसरेत् प्राप्यमन्ते पदं ते ॥ ९९-२ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: A devotee who offers Yagna worship etc., to Vishnu, the one who existed before the creation, one who created everything, one who is every moment new, who is Lord of all majesties, or a devotee who describes the incarnations of Bhagwan Krishna, which is the greatest, he alone will be happy and full of renown, and at the end of his life will quickly attain Bhagwan’s abode.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
ādyāyāśeṣakartre pratinimiṣanavīnāya bhartre vibhūte-
-rbhaktātmā viṣṇave yaḥ pradiśati havirādīni yajñārcanādau |
kṛṣṇādyaṃ janma yo vā mahadiha mahato varṇayetso’yameva
prītaḥ pūrṇo yaśobhistvaritamabhisaret prāpyamante padaṃ te || 99-2 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
हे स्तोतारः कवीन्द्रास्तमिह खलु यथा चेतयध्वे तथैव
व्यक्तं वेदस्य सारं प्रणुवत जननोपात्तलीलाकथाभिः ।
जानन्तश्चास्य नामान्यखिलसुखकराणीति सङ्कीर्तयध्वं
हे विष्णो कीर्तनाद्यैस्तव खलु महतस्तत्त्वबोधं भजेयम् ॥ ९९-३ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Bhattathiri requested poets to sing the detailed glory of  Bhagwan, the essence of all Vedas, detailing HIS incarnations taken on this earth, chant the names of Bhagwan which can only give  endless joy. Bhattathiri wished to earn the supreme consciousness by chanting Bhagwan’s various names.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
he stotāraḥ kavīndrāstamiha khalu yathā cetayadhve tathaiva
vyaktaṃ vedasya sāraṃ praṇuvata jananopāttalīlākathābhiḥ |
jānantaścāsya nāmānyakhilasukhakarāṇīti saṅkīrtayadhvaṃ
he viṣṇo kīrtanādyaistava khalu mahatastattvabodhaṃ bhajeyam || 99-3 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
विष्णोः कर्माणि सम्पश्यत मनसि सदा यैः स धर्मानबध्ना-
-द्यानीन्द्रस्यैष भृत्यः प्रियसख इव च व्यातनोत् क्षेमकारी ।
वीक्षन्ते योगसिद्धाः परपदमनिśं यस्य सम्यक् प्रकाशं
विप्रेन्द्रा जागरूकाः कृतबहुनुतयो यच्च निर्भासयन्ते ॥ ९९-४ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: One should meditate on the great deeds of Lord Vishnu, by which HE established righteousness, helped Indra sometimes as a servant or as a friend, bringing welfare to the entire universe through his incarnations. The great saints and siddha purushas contemplated always on his supreme state of consciousness.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
viṣṇoḥ karmāṇi sampaśyata manasi sadā yaiḥ sa dharmānabadhnā-
-dyānīndrasyaiṣa bhṛtyaḥ priyasakha iva ca vyātanot kṣemakārī |
vīkṣante yogasiddhāḥ parapadamaniśaṃ yasya samyak prakāśaṃ
viprendrā jāgarūkāḥ kṛtabahunutayo yacca nirbhāsayante || 99-4 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
नो जातो जायमानोऽपि च समधिगतस्त्वन्महिम्नोऽवसानं
देव श्रेयांसि विद्वान् प्रतिमुहुरपि ते नाम शंसामि विष्णो ।
तं त्वां संस्तौमि नानाविधनुतिवचनैरस्य लोकत्रयस्या-
-प्यूर्ध्वं विभ्राजमाने विरचितवसतिं तत्र वैकुण्ठलोके ॥ ९९-५ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: No one in this universe knew Bhagwan’s glory completely either in the past or going to know, in the future. Knowing that chanting Bhagwan’s names gives the best life, Bhattathiri chanted HIS names often and invoked Bhagwan who resides in the vaikunta above all the three lokas, with hymns and stotras in praise of HIS glory.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
no jāto jāyamāno’pi ca samadhigatastvanmahimno’vasānaṃ
deva śreyāṃsi vidvān pratimuhurapi te nāma śaṃsāmi viṣṇo |
taṃ tvāṃ saṃstaumi nānāvidhanutivacanairasya lokatrayasyā-
-pyūrdhvaṃ vibhrājamāne viracitavasatiṃ tatra vaikuṇṭhaloke || 99-5 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
आपः सृष्ट्यादिजन्याः प्रथममयि विभो गर्भदेशे दधुस्त्वां
यत्र त्वय्येव जीवा जलशयन हरे सङ्गता ऐक्यमापन् ।
तस्याजस्य प्रभो ते विनिहितमभवत्पद्ममेकं हि नाभौ
दिक्पत्रं यत्किलाहुः कनकधरणिभृत् कर्णिकं लोकरूपम् ॥ ९९-६ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: This world was filled with water in the very beginning & Bhagwan reclining in the waters who then is the embodiment of all jeevas. A lotus flower  with 8 petals arose from the navel of Bhagwan & this represents the eight quarters and the golden Mahaameru as its pericarp representing all the worlds.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
āpaḥ sṛṣṭyādijanyāḥ prathamamayi vibho garbhadeśe dadhustvāṃ
yatra tvayyeva jīvā jalaśayana hare saṅgatā aikyamāpan |
tasyājasya prabho te vinihitamabhavatpadmamekaṃ hi nābhau
dikpatraṃ yatkilāhuḥ kanakadharaṇibhṛt karṇikaṃ lokarūpam || 99-6 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
हे लोका विष्णुरेतद्भुवनमजनयत्तन्न जानीथ यूयं
युष्माकं ह्यन्तरस्थं किमपि तदपरं विद्यते विष्णुरूपम् ।
नीहारप्रख्यमायापरिवृतमनसो मोहिता नामरूपैः
प्राणप्रीत्यैकतृप्ताश्चरथ मखपरा हन्त नेच्छा मुकुन्दे ॥ ९९-७ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Bhattathiri empathized with those people who are unaware that  Bhagwan created this world. Many have not realized that HIS limitless form, resides in every soul. This is because they are blinded by Maaya and always concentrate on fulfilling their sensual and material desires and involve themselves in doing things to make themselves happy. It is sad to note, that such people are not devoted to Lord Mukunda.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
he lokā viṣṇuretadbhuvanamajanayattanna jānītha yūyaṃ
yuṣmākaṃ hyantarasthaṃ kimapi tadaparaṃ vidyate viṣṇurūpam |
nīhāraprakhamāyāparivṛtamanaso mohitā nāmarūpaiḥ
prāṇaprītyaikatṛptāścaratha makhaparā hanta necchā mukunde || 99-7 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
मूर्ध्नामक्ष्णां पदानां वहसि खलु सहस्राणि सम्पूर्य विश्वं
तत् प्रोत्क्रम्यापि तिष्ठन् परिमितविवरे भासि चित्तान्तरेऽपि ।
भूतं भव्यं च सर्वं परपुरुष भवान् किं च देहेन्द्रियादि-
-ष्वाविष्टोऽप्युद्गतत्वादमृतसुखरसं चानुभुङ्क्षे त्वमेव ॥ ९९-८ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Bhagwan with HIS thousands of heads, eyes, and feet fills the whole universe and transcends beyond it. Yet HE is present in the limited space of the heart of people. HE existed in the past and will remain in the future too.  HE is all-pervading in body and senses and still enjoys the supreme state of liberation.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
mūrdhnāmakṣṇāṃ padānāṃ vahasi khalu sahasrāṇi sampūrya viśvaṃ
tat protkramyāpi tiṣṭhan parimitavivare bhāsi cittāntare’pi |
bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ ca sarvaṃ parapuruṣa bhavān kiṃ ca dehendriyādi-
-ṣvāviṣṭo’pyudgatatvādamṛtasukharasaṃ cānubhuṅkṣe tvameva || 99-8 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
यत्तु त्रैलोक्यरूपं दधदपि च ततो निर्गताऽनन्तशुद्ध-
-ज्ञानात्मा वर्तसे त्वं तव खलु महिमा सोऽपि तावान् किमन्यत् ।
स्तोकस्ते भाग एवाखिलभुवनतया दृश्यते त्र्यंशकल्पं
भूयिष्ठं सान्द्रमोदात्मकमुपरि ततो भाति तस्मै नमस्ते ॥ ९९-९ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Bhagwan constitutes three worlds and transcends beyond it as eternal, pure, knowledge consciousness form and HIS limitless glory is the only reason for it. Bhattathiri prostrated and surrendered before that supreme consciousness, which is only one-fourth & the remaining three-fourths transcend all the worlds and remain in a state of eternal bliss.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
yattu trailokyarūpaṃ dadhadapi ca tato nirgatā’nantaśuddha-
-jñānātmā vartase tvaṃ tava khalu mahimā so’pi tāvān kimanyat |
stokaste bhāga evākhilabhuvanatayā dṛśyate tryaṃśakalpaṃ
bhūyiṣṭhaṃ sāndramodātmakamupari tato bhāti tasmai namaste || 99-9 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
अव्यक्तं ते स्वरूपं दुरधिगमतमं तत्तु शुद्धैकसत्त्वं
व्यक्तं चाप्येतदेव स्फुटममृतरसाम्भोधिकल्लोलतुल्यम् ।
सर्वोत्कृष्टामभीष्टां तदिह गुणरसेनैव चित्तं हरन्तीं
मूर्तिं ते संश्रयेऽहं पवनपुरपते पाहि मां कृष्ण रोगात् ॥ ९९-१० ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Bhagwan’s manifested form (Nirguna swaroopam) is difficult to grasp.  HIS pure, sattva, supreme blissful form (Saguna swaroopam)  can be understood clearly. This shining Krishna form appears like waves in the ocean of nectar.  Hence Bhattathiri loved to pray and offer pooja to the idol of Lord Krishna who is the supreme & requested Bhagwan to cure him of all his afflictions.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
avyaktaṃ te svarūpaṃ duradhigamatamaṃ tattu śuddhaikasattvaṃ
vyaktaṃ cāpyetadeva sphuṭamamṛtarasāmbhodhikallolatulyam |
sarvotkṛṣṭāmabhīṣṭāṃ tadiha guṇarasenaiva cittaṃ harantīṃ
mūrtiṃ te saṃśraye’haṃ pavanapurapate pāhi māṃ kṛṣṇa rogāt || 99-10 ||
